description: This file defines the CallsignTLS class and related macros for managing thread-local callsign information within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes methods for setting and retrieving callsign data, as well as a guard class for temporary callsign changes.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: Manages thread-local storage for callsign information, allowing setting and retrieving callsign data within different threads.

classes.name: CallSignTLSGuard
classes.description: A guard class that temporarily sets a callsign for the scope of its lifetime and resets it upon destruction.

classes.name: CallsignAccess
classes.description: A template struct providing access to the callsign associated with a module name.

methods.name: Callsign()
methods.description: Retrieves the current callsign for the thread.

methods.name: Callsign(const char*)
methods.description: Sets the callsign for the current thread.

methods.name: Name(const char*)
methods.description: Sets the internal name string for the callsign object.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the current name string or nullptr if empty.
